description: Shared GHASH block-accounting vectors for one AES-GCM invocation: B = ceil(|AAD| / 16) + ceil(|C| / 16) + 1, where C is the encrypted payload without the tag. AAD 43 = v3 record AAD, AAD 36 = filename metadata AAD. Used by web (vitest) and desktop (xUnit) to keep the per-DEK block accounting identical on both platforms.
